title: Split authoritative schema reads from bounded recent-artifact searches
trigger_preconditions: A discovery wrapper combines a repository-wide content search with an authoritative schema read.
failure_signature: The combined repository-wide workflow search and schema read exceeded its bounded wrapper without an attributable result.
candidate_workaround: Read the exact current schema directly, then search only the relevant recent phase roots with a separate bound.
recurrence_guard: Do not attach a broad historical corpus search to an authoritative small-file read.
rollback: Give the timed-out wrapper zero evidence credit and leave repository state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local read-only discovery only; no scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
